exposure: Prophylactic sublingual PGE1 in addition to standard uterotonics
cohort: The study included 62 women undergoing lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) at Rangnath Hospital, Kolhapur.
finding: Prophylactic sublingual PGE1 during LSCS significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss and postpartum haemoglobin fall compared to standard uterotonics alone.
mod_finding: The study's primary finding is that prophylactic sublingual PGE1 during caesarean section significantly reduces blood loss and haemoglobin drop in women undergoing this specific mode of birth.
